body:
@vinhlh Using connectPagination along with https://github.com/avocode/react-shortcuts or https://github.com/chrisui/react-hotkeys I believe you should be able to achieve what you want.

Then should our own widgets handle that for you and expose that to the user, that's a tricky question. @Shipow do you think our pagination widget should implement keyboard shortcuts abilities by default?

We did implement shortcuts for the searchbox for instance because multiple websites had defined default shortcuts to access searchboxes. As for pagination do you know any very common website that had implemented it?

Maybe first we could do a guide if this is something people are looking for.
